title: 美国失业保障体系为何失灵？改革呼声渐起
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: America's unemployment system is broken. A lot of Americans are worried about losing their job to AI, or someone they know losing their job to AI.
segments.zh: 美国的失业保障体系存在缺陷。许多美国人担心自己或认识的人会被AI取代工作。

segments.en: It's potential disruption in the labor market. But that in some ways is distraction from the existing problems that the labor market already suffers from.
segments.zh: 这可能是劳动力市场的潜在扰动，但在某种程度上，它分散了人们对劳动力市场现有问题的注意力。

segments.en: Problems that make the fear of job loss so much worse.
segments.zh: 这些问题使得对失业的恐惧更加严重。

segments.en: AI isn't really a point of policy yet. But the rest of the problems in the labor market, they definitely are.
segments.zh: AI尚未成为政策焦点，但劳动力市场的其他问题绝对是政策重点。

segments.en: America has had a short-term unemployment system since the Social Security Act of 1935.
segments.zh: 自1935年《社会保障法》以来，美国一直实行短期失业保障制度。

segments.en: And even though it performs well in some respects, it is irrevocably broken in others.
segments.zh: 尽管它在某些方面表现良好，但在其他方面却存在无法修复的缺陷。

segments.en: And it's time to fix it. In the 91 years that it's been in existence, we've learned a lot about what it does right and a lot about what it gets wrong.
segments.zh: 是时候修复它了。在它存在的91年里，我们对其优点和缺点都有了深入了解。

segments.en: And what it gets wrong is simply overwhelming what gets right. First problem is that it's a state-based system, which means that the taxes that support benefits
segments.zh: 而其缺点远远超过了优点。第一个问题是，这是一个基于州的体系，意味着支持福利的税收和福利本身因州而异。

segments.en: and the benefits themselves vary state by state. In fact, they're determined by every single legislature in the country and they're not required to have any type of coordination.
segments.zh: 事实上，它们由全国每个立法机构决定，且不要求任何形式的协调。

segments.en: That means two people who work for the same company for the same amount of time earn the same amount of money and the same job are laid off can have vastly different amount of support in an unemployment system.
segments.zh: 这意味着，为同一家公司工作相同时间、赚取相同薪水、从事相同工作的两个人被解雇后，在失业保障体系中获得的补助可能大相径庭。

segments.en: State level variation is one problem, but the bigger problem that sits as a heart of our unemployment system is called experience rating.
segments.zh: 各州差异是一个问题，但失业体系的核心问题在于经验评级。

segments.en: Employers pay taxes into the unemployment insurance trust fund in their state for every worker they have.
segments.zh: 雇主为每位员工向州失业保障信托基金缴税。

segments.en: But the rate is set by how many prior employees successfully claimed benefits.
segments.zh: 但税率取决于先前有多少员工成功申领了福利。
